english.title: Fail to comply with order to remove obstruction from highway
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being subject to an order dated **(..SPECIFY DATE OF ORDER..) issued by **(..SPECIFY COURT..) Magistrates Court, under Section 137ZA of the Highways Act 1980 requiring the removal of an obstruction, namely **(..SPECIFY OBSTRUCTION..), from the highway, namely **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY..), failed, without reasonable excuse, to comply with that order
english.legislation: Contrary to section 137ZA(3) of the Highways Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
subject to an order to remove obstruction failed to comply

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) If the offence is continued after conviction, then a further offence is committed, the penalty being a fine not exceeding one twentieth of the greater of £5,000 or level four on the standard scale for each day on which the offence is so continued.
(ii) See offence wordings H4128 and H488 for associated offence "Wilful Obstruction of Highway"
(iii) This offence is inserted by Section 64 of the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

See also note (i) where offence continues after conviction

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
